concept.title: Operator console (coming soon)
concept.shortdesc: A web UI for operators of deployments is in development.

conbody.p: Today, operators manage a deployment with the admin API and the seed command, behind a bearer token. The console will replace the token with staff sign-in. Tenants and billing arrive with multi-tenancy, when one deployment serves several docs sites.

The console will open this documentation in its help panel, using the opend-console keys this site already declares. Until its screens are documented, keys such as tenants.detail fall back to this page.
